5744-7487-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5744-7487-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-2020-8164.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

650-3175-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

Use Switcheroo to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2.
3174-5571-6495--6.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2893-3470-6664-7941.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Syndicate Liquidators trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Syndicate Liquidators trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Ugin, the Ineffable.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

2350-5078-6089.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Stone Calendar.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.

Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

Draw a card.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain life.
Well of Lost Dreams and Cleric Class trigger.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.

624-670-1619-4089.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-1619-4089.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Phantasmal Image and Glasspool Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-1619-4089.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

880-6664-7705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6664-7705.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the land enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1385-2469-5220-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

4243-4377-4423.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Mystic Sanctuary using Venser, the Sojourner.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.
4243-4377-4423.notes: Mystic Sanctuary can be tapped for mana before casting Walk the Aeons if it's able to do so.

2173-4496-5220-6634.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing itself.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3088-7434--148.notablePrerequisites:
There are legal targets for the spell with {X} in its mana cost, if applicable.
You have enough mana to cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost reduced by {C}{C}, accounting for {X} to be 2 or greater if you wish to gain life.
1978-3088-7434--148.description:
Animate Brass Infiniscope.
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C} and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 as desired.
Cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost, with {X} being at least 2 if you wish to gain life.
Each instance of Brass Infiniscope's delayed triggered ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain half X life, rounded down, for each trigger.
1978-3088-7434--148.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

1379-1651-5640-6859.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Servant of Tymaret, targeting Servant of Tymaret.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and Servant of Tymaret.
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

2421-3101-3705-4050.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix and Runaway Steam-Kin trigger.
Resolve the Skyfire Phoenix trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Runaway Steam-Kin trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

703-4394-5231-5929.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {R}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

2724-3080-5299-5775.notablePrerequisites: Fortune does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2724-3080-5299-5775.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Fortune's saddle ability by tapping Exchange of Words, causing Fortune to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Fortune as an attacker.
At the end of your combat phase, Fortune triggers, blinking it and Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

874-5445-5660.notablePrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Evolution Witness.
874-5445-5660.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Delif's Cone ability.
Repeat.

Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Branchsnap Lorian.
If Grafted Wargear was attached to a creature, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice Branchsnap Lorian.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When Branchsnap Lorian enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1742-2051-2546-4578.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
1742-2051-2546-4578.description:
Activate Tranquil Thicket's cycling ability by paying {G} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Tranquil Thicket ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a land card, adding {B}.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Tranquil Thicket and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

618-3957-4613-5070.notablePrerequisites: Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
618-3957-4613-5070.description:
Activate Famished Paladin using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Famished Paladin token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Famished Paladin's toughness.
Each Famished Paladin you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.

2292-3764-4871.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

1601-1636-4484.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
1601-1636-4484.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Ebondeath enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1242-1562.description:
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

152-1283-4600-4772.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Chromatic Orrery.
Activate the Chromatic Orrery copies first abilities by tapping them, adding {10}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens' second abilities to draw infinite cards.

220-2584-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Brash Taunter.
You have a way to deal damage to Brash Taunter.
220-2584-3828.description:
Deal damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter and Druid's Call triggers.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing that much damage to target opponent.
Resolve the Druid's Call trigger, creating that many 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Each Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Pandemonium that many times.
Resolve all but one Pandemonium triggers, causing the Squirrels to each deal one damage to any target.
Resolve the final Pandemonium trigger, causing a Squirrel to deal one damage to Brash Taunter.
Repeat from step 2.

380-4846.description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon by paying {3}{R}{R}{R}.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability and Miirym.
Holding priority, you may activate all mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
The Worldgorger Dragon token enters the battlefield, exiling all other permanents you control.
The nontoken Worldgorger Dragon's second ability triggers, returning nothing to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Worldgorger Dragon's first ability from step 2, exiling all other permanents you control.
The token Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2 as many times as desired. When you wish to break the loop, repeat the below steps after you've completed step 3.
Resolve the Worldgorger Dragon trigger, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the token Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Worldgorger Dragon.
When the nontoken Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it from exile to the battlefield.
